::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/subscriptions/{sub}/upcoming_renewals"}
#docs
Stops at the last cycle of a fixed term and at a scheduled cancellation or pause. Empty for a subscription that cannot skip.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |
| `sub` | `string` | **yes** | Subscription id (sub_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The items. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type; always `upcoming_renewal`. One of `upcoming_renewal`. |
| `data.renewal_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the renewal runs. Pass this value to `skip_renewal`. |
| `data.skipped` | `boolean` | True if this renewal is scheduled to be skipped. |
| `data.renewal_skip` | `string` | The renewal skip id, when skipped. |
| `data.changeable` | `boolean` | False within 48 hours of the renewal, when skips and undos are closed. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | List of upcoming_renewal |
| `404` | No such subscription |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/subscriptions/sub_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/upcoming_renewals" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
